query: What combination of quasi-experimental designs (DiD, event studies, RD at packaging-reg thresholds, synthetic controls, firm-level IV) most credibly isolates shrink-driven unit-price changes from concurrent demand shocks?

response.query: What combination of quasi-experimental designs (DiD, event studies, RD at packaging-reg thresholds, synthetic controls, firm-level IV) most credibly isolates shrink-driven unit-price changes from concurrent demand shocks?
response.answer: Difference-in-Differences (DiD), event studies, and synthetic controls most credibly isolate shrink-driven unit-price changes from concurrent demand shocks.
